title: Source: Mercor hit over $2B in gross revenue run rate in June, double its pace in April, and is profitable on a free cash flow basis (Julia Hornstein/The Information)
summary: Julia Hornstein / The Information: Source: Mercor hit over $2B in gross revenue run rate in June, double its pace in April, and is profitable on a free cash flow basis — Mercor hit over $2 billion in gross revenue run rate in June, double its pace earlier this year, according to a person with direct knowledge of the company's financials.
